request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:FARM

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass and soil slab under the farm so the barn, wheat field, fence and haystack stand directly on a transparent background with nothing under them. Paint the whole barn roof solid bright red with darker red shading. Make every wall timber and the fence pale straw yellow, never brown. Keep the layout, outline and art style the same.
